title: Ethiopian Udon Noodle Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with homemade udon noodles and Ethiopian spices.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tbsp of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, bell pepper, and carrots. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the vegetable broth and water. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the homemade udon noodles to the pot. Cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the noodles are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley or cilantro.
